hrAssistant.title: Intelligent HR Assistant — ENGTP / SONATRACH
hrAssistant.description: Intelligent conversational assistant dedicated to human resources, based on a RAG architecture that searches internal documents and generates contextualized answers with citations.
hrAssistant.highlight: Local AI architecture designed for confidential enterprise data.
hrAssistant.overview: A conversational assistant for ENGTP's (a Sonatrach subsidiary) HR department, allowing natural-language queries over the company's internal documentation.
hrAssistant.problem: HR teams had to manually search through numerous internal documents, which slowed down responses to common questions.
hrAssistant.solution: Built a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture combining hybrid search and contextualized generation with source citations, fully deployed on-premise to guarantee data confidentiality.
hrAssistant.challenges: Guaranteeing full data confidentiality while maintaining satisfactory answer quality with locally-run models.
hrAssistant.results: A functional assistant able to answer common HR questions by relying on internal documentation, with no dependency on an external API.

learnhub.title: LearnHub
learnhub.description: Modern web platform dedicated to online learning, giving users access to courses and educational content.
learnhub.overview: An e-learning platform enabling course creation, user enrollment, and management of educational content.
learnhub.problem: Needed a simple, well-structured platform to organize online courses with clear role management.
learnhub.solution: Developed a clean architecture with separated routers/services/data-access layers, JWT authentication and role management (student, instructor, administrator).
learnhub.challenges: Structuring a clear, scalable backend architecture from the start.
learnhub.results: A functional platform demonstrating a clean, maintainable full-stack architecture.

aiAgentMcp.title: Autonomous AI Agent — Function Calling
aiAgentMcp.description: An agent that dynamically selects the tools it needs — document search, CRUD operations, data queries — to fulfill a request, via the standard Model Context Protocol. Automatic tool generation from an OpenAPI spec, with granular permissions, dry-run mode, and full action logging.
aiAgentMcp.overview: An AI agent able to dynamically choose and execute the right tools to fulfill a user request, via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
aiAgentMcp.problem: A useful AI assistant needs to be able to act on a real system (search, CRUD, queries), not just generate text.
aiAgentMcp.solution: Implemented an agent orchestrated with LangGraph, exposing its capabilities via MCP, with automatic tool generation from an OpenAPI spec and a granular permission system.
aiAgentMcp.challenges: Guaranteeing strict control over the agent's actions while preserving real decision-making autonomy.
aiAgentMcp.results: A functional agent able to execute concrete tasks on a backend in a secure and traceable way.

aiSqlAssistant.title: AI SQL Assistant
aiSqlAssistant.description: A RAG pipeline built from scratch, indexing a PostgreSQL schema into pgvector to generate context-aware SQL queries. Defense-in-depth architecture: strict syntax validation limited to read-only statements, combined with a read-only database role.
aiSqlAssistant.overview: An assistant that translates natural-language questions into secure SQL queries, grounded in the database's real schema.
aiSqlAssistant.problem: Querying a database normally requires knowing SQL and the exact table schema.
aiSqlAssistant.solution: Vector indexing of the PostgreSQL schema with pgvector, contextualized SQL query generation, then strict validation via SQLGlot limiting execution to read-only queries.
features: Vector indexing of the database schema
aiSqlAssistant.challenges: Guaranteeing that no generated query could modify or compromise data, via a double security layer.
aiSqlAssistant.results: An assistant able to generate relevant, secure SQL queries from natural-language questions.
